core.title: Retro Two Tone Cabinet Pull, RK International CP-36
tags: Retro Two Tone 3 Inch Cabinet Pulls

text.description_html:
RK International CP-36, Retro Two Tone Cabinet Pull

With fantastic retro flair, this cabinet pull made by RK International joins form with function beautifully. The Retro Two Tone Cabinet Pull is available in 6 finish combinations (click on picture to the right to see them all) including polished chrome with polished brass, black nickel with polished chrome, and oil rubbed bronze with polished brass. It installs easily with the included hardware. It is available in a 3 inch center to center and a 3-1/2 inch center to center.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-36 Retro Two Tone Swirl Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    RKI-CP-36
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
    • Overall Length: 3-15/16"
    • Width: 9/16"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"

    RKI-CP-37
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-1/2"
    • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 9/16"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"

Sold Individually
